product_overview: FiredIn is an AI-powered hiring platform for experienced professionals who are laid off or looking to switch jobs. It helps candidates get verified through a one-time AI interview and helps recruiters review verified applicants, post jobs, and invite candidates.
core_goals: Register as a candidate or recruiter
Complete candidate onboarding and verification to earn a verification score and badge
Browse and apply for jobs as a verified candidate
Post jobs and review applicants as a recruiter
Invite candidates and manage interview scheduling

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Public entry point that introduces the platform and directs candidates and recruiters into the correct sign-up path.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Read the platform introduction -> Choose the candidate path -> Continue to candidate registration
Navigate to / -> Read the platform introduction -> Choose the recruiter path -> Continue to recruiter registration

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Account access for candidates and recruiters, including registration, login, and password recovery.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/register -> Select the candidate role -> Enter name, email, and password -> Submit registration form -> Continue to candidate onboarding
Navigate to /auth/register -> Select the recruiter role -> Enter company name, email, and password -> Submit registration form -> Access the recruiter account
Navigate to /auth/login -> Select the job seeker role -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> Access the candidate area
Navigate to /auth/login -> Select the recruiter role -> Enter email and password -> Submit login form -> Access the recruiter area
Navigate to /auth/forgot-password -> Enter email -> Request reset code -> Enter received code and new password -> Submit password reset -> Return to login

features.name: Candidate Onboarding
features.description: An 8-step setup wizard where candidates provide profile, work history, skills, resume, education, preferences, and a headline before verification.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/onboarding -> Enter basic profile details -> Continue through work status, employment history, and skills steps -> Upload resume -> Enter education and job preferences -> Write a professional headline -> Complete onboarding
Navigate to /candidate/onboarding -> Review each step -> Go back to update earlier answers -> Continue forward -> Complete onboarding

features.name: Candidate Verification Interview
features.description: A one-time AI-led interview that uses the candidate’s resume and produces a verification score and badge.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/verify/{id} -> Start the verification interview -> Answer resume-based questions -> Continue through the interview -> Finish the session -> See the verification result and score
Navigate to /candidate/verify/{id} -> Start the verification interview -> Provide responses that do not support the profile -> Finish the session -> See a lower verification score

features.name: Candidate Jobs and Applications
features.description: Job browsing and application flow for verified candidates, with access gated until verification is complete.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/jobs -> Browse available jobs -> Select a job to review -> Apply for the job -> See the application submission confirmation
Navigate to /candidate/jobs -> Try to apply before verification -> See that application is blocked until verification is complete

features.name: Candidate Scheduling
features.description: A time-slot picker that lets candidates schedule an interview after being invited by a recruiter.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/schedule -> Review available time slots -> Select a preferred slot -> Confirm the booking -> See scheduling confirmation
Navigate to /candidate/schedule -> Select a different time slot -> Confirm the new booking -> See the updated scheduling confirmation

features.name: Interview Room
features.description: An AI interview room for the scheduled meeting, featuring voice interaction, transcript viewing, and interview phase tracking.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/room/[interviewId] -> Allow camera and microphone access -> Speak responses during the interview -> Watch the transcript update -> Complete the interview session

features.name: Candidate Scorecard
features.description: Post-interview results page showing the AI assessment, score rings, dimension bars, and written feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /candidate/scorecard/[interviewId] -> Review the overall score -> Inspect the assessment dimensions -> Read the feedback summary -> Compare performance across categories

features.name: Recruiter Dashboard
features.description: Recruiter home view with summary stats, recent applications, and upcoming interviews.
user_flows: Navigate to the recruiter area -> Review dashboard statistics -> Inspect recent applications -> Check upcoming interviews -> Continue to other recruiter tools

features.name: Job Management
features.description: Recruiter tools for viewing posted jobs and creating new jobs with AI-assisted descriptions.
user_flows: Navigate to /recruiter/jobs -> Review existing job postings and application counts -> Open the new job flow -> Enter job details -> Generate and save the job description -> Return to the job list
Navigate to /recruiter/jobs/new -> Enter job title and requirements -> Use AI assistance to draft the description -> Save the job posting -> See the new posting in the list

features.name: Candidate Review and Invites
features.description: Recruiter view of applicants with verification scores, status badges, and invite actions.
user_flows: Navigate to /recruiter/candidates -> Review applicant verification scores and badges -> Identify a strong candidate -> Send an invite -> See the candidate marked accordingly

Navigate to /recruiter/candidates -> Filter by applicant status mentally through the table -> Review candidate details and score -> Send an invite to selected applicants -> Continue reviewing the list

features.name: Recruiter Assessments
features.description: List of AI assessment results used by recruiters to review candidate outcomes and integrity signals.
user_flows: Navigate to /recruiter/assessments -> Review assessment verdicts -> Open a result -> Inspect the score and integrity score -> Compare candidates across assessments

features.name: Recruiter Analytics
features.description: Hiring analytics view with KPI cards, funnel visualization, and weekly activity trends.
user_flows: Navigate to /recruiter/analytics -> Review KPI cards -> Inspect the hiring pipeline funnel -> Review weekly activity trends -> Use the insights to guide hiring decisions

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Unread notification badge and dropdown for viewing and marking notifications as read.
user_flows: View the unread count badge -> Open the notifications dropdown -> Read new notifications -> Mark a notification as read -> See the unread count decrease

features.name: Jobs API
features.description: CRUD for job postings with JD embedding generation.
